acceptanceCriteria: Release archives carry a verifiable publisher signature or Sigstore/GitHub artifact attestation, and INSTALL.md documents verification.
A Homebrew tap (or an owner-chosen alternative channel) installs a qualified release.
The Windows exclusion is either lifted or stated with its owning tickets (V1-0399, V1-0400).
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner-requested gap analysis of Corvint against competing context tools, current standards and a trial on a local clone of MeVille (TypeScript, about 4,600 tracked files). Releases are unsigned (docs/INSTALL.md:23: checksum agreement detects changed bytes, not publisher identity), Windows is excluded (docs/INSTALL.md:22), there is no Homebrew tap or other package channel, and host adapters cannot be installed from the Core artifact (V1-0345). V1-0092 attests the CEM, not the binaries. Install friction is the first thing an untouched-repository user meets (V1-0019).
title: distribution: signed release archives and a package-manager install channel
